spec.condition: UTC hour in {8,9,10,11,12}  == the 08:00-13:00 UTC window; EVERY M5 bar in the window
spec.baseline: complement of the condition: all M5 bars with UTC hour outside [8,13)
spec.headline_statistic: P(+100 project pips touched before -80 project pips)
spec.tie_rule: both barriers inside one M5 bar -> ADVERSE (0)
spec.dedup: NONE - every eligible M5 bar is one observation (overlapping)
spec.overlap_handling: day-clustered standard errors; separate 1-per-288-bar non-overlap check
spec.missing_data: weekend/holiday gaps left as-is; forward window walks bar index, not clock
spec.timing_statistic: median of first-touch bar index of the +100p UP barrier ONLY, censored cases DROPPED
